The '''Axehead frigate''' was a [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] model used by the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]].

==Description==
Unlike other Republic designs with a hammerheaded bow-section, this design had a horizontal rather than vertical protrusion, to aid in landing and deploying troops. The frigate was capable of atmospheric entry and could carry multiple [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] squads in its forward upper assault deck, unleashing them onto the battlefield upon landing. The aerial vehicle deck was above the central axis of the vessel, while a second assault deck was placed below, with a platform door lowering to deploy ground troops.

==History==
[[Reciprocity|One]] of these frigates deployed [[Revanchist]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] onto [[Essien]] to battle [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Neo-Crusaders]] who had taken the planet weeks before.
